rule_lines.title: A thermostat, controller or actuator listed beside a PIBCV is part of the PIBCV item, not a second item
rule_lines.detail: with the line 'thermostat / actuator included in the PIBCV item'; words naming another valve are never folded in; a 2-way valve 'with thermostat' keeps its refusal; the line sits on the item it changed, whatever made the reading (this rule or the model), and is never written twice

rule_lines.title: An NRV the BoQ calls dual plate is priced as the Dual Plate NRV, over the flanged rule
rule_lines.detail: 'dual plate' in the item's own words, the row or its nearest heading; the line sits on the item it changed, whatever made the reading (this rule or the model), and is never written twice

rule_lines.title: A valve the BoQ calls portable or handed over is priced supply only, quoting those words
rule_lines.detail: installation 0; 'Supply of' and 'Supply and provisioning' alone stay supply + installation

rule_lines.title: A small valve with no size of its own that the BoQ ties to a pressure gauge is part of the gauge
rule_lines.detail: a ball, gate or needle valve the row ties to the gauge ('for isolation', 'of suitable size', 'cost ... included', 'with syphon'); a valve with its own size stays its own item; the line sits on the item it changed, whatever made the reading (this rule or the model), and is never written twice

rule_lines.title: An air vent's size belongs to the ball valve beside it, and '25mm"' reads 25 mm
rule_lines.detail: the air vent has one price for any size, so a size read on it moves to a sizeless ball valve on the same row; a stray inch mark after 'mm' is dropped; below 15 mm -> 15 by the ladder

rule_lines.title: 'BV' or 'Bal valve' at 40 mm and below is read as a Ball Valve
rule_lines.detail: in amber, switchable; never 'ball valve' or 'balancing'; above 40 mm the model's reading stands

rule_lines.title: A valve 'with strainer' adds a Y-strainer of the same size as its own line
rule_lines.detail: an integral or built-in strainer too; a Set naming one valve with and one without a strainer is three lines (valve with, valve without, strainer); a strainer the model already listed is never doubled; below 50 mm -> 50 by the ladder; the line sits on the item it changed, whatever made the reading (this rule or the model), and is never written twice

rule_lines.title: A ball valve with no size that the BoQ ties to the strainer's drain is part of the strainer
rule_lines.detail: 'ball valve for strainer drain', 'drain valve ... included / part of'; a ball valve with its own size stays its own item; the line sits on the item it changed, whatever made the reading (this rule or the model), and is never written twice

rule_lines.title: A valve described as both balancing and modulating is the PIBCV
rule_lines.detail: both words in one valve's own words; the nearest heading counts only for an item already read as a 2-way or balancing valve; never a second PIBCV on a row that has one; the line sits on the item it changed, whatever made the reading (this rule or the model), and is never written twice

rule_lines.title: A provision for a thermometer or thermowell is priced as the Misc Test Plug / Thermowell
rule_lines.detail: the line sits on the item it changed, whatever made the reading (this rule or the model), and is never written twice

rule_lines.title: A high-rangeability control valve is a 2-way modulating valve
rule_lines.detail: the sheet stocks 20-32 mm, so above 32 mm the size refuses ('valve size N is above the largest size on the sheet (32)'); a named unstocked item under that heading keeps its own words

rule_lines.title: A count written before an item ('two', '2 nos', 'pair of') prices that many
rule_lines.detail: never 'two way' or '2-way'; the item's own quantity where its block has one, else that many items; the line sits on the item it changed, whatever made the reading (this rule or the model), and is never written twice

rule_lines.title: The size in the row's own words wins over a size in the text appended to it
rule_lines.detail: only a size written in mm or NB counts ('PN 16', 'RS 485' are not sizes); it also fills an item that read none; the line sits on the item it changed, whatever made the reading (this rule or the model), and is never written twice

rule_lines.title: Under a heading 'with and without strainer', a row stating only a size prices the valve alone
rule_lines.detail: with the note to add Y-strainers by hand - the BoQ does not say how many have one

rule_lines.title: A swing check NRV is not on our sheet and is refused by name
rule_lines.detail: 'No SKU in the catalogue for swing check NRV - price this row by hand'; never priced as Flanged or Dual Plate

A thermometer with its (necessary) isolation valves is one thermometer, with a note
rule_lines.detail: no valve item for its isolation valves

rule_lines.title: A provision to fix a pressure gauge later is priced as the Test Plug / Thermowell, with a note
rule_lines.detail: sockets, ball valves or a siphon to fix a gauge later; the gauge itself is not included

rule_lines.title: A balancing valve with integrated P/T test points is the balancing valve alone, with a note
rule_lines.detail: the test points are part of it

rule_lines.title: An on-off pressure independent valve is priced as the PIBCV, with a note to check the price
An air vent named only in the heading does not add itself to a row that buys only a ball valve
rule_lines.detail: the ball valve alone, no note; an air purge, air release valve or air eliminator in the row's own words is the air vent; '... with (a) ball valve' keeps the heading's air vent with its ball valve

attribute_definitions.label: Misc item
attribute_definitions.note: Which Misc item THIS row buys: a thermometer or temperature gauge; a pressure gauge; rubber bellows, a flexible pipe connection or an expansion joint; a test plug, test point or thermowell. Answer 'none of these' for anything else (a flow meter, a gauge cock) and copy its words into 'Item as written'. A thermowell named WITH a thermometer, and a syphon, gauge cock, needle valve or small isolation cock named WITH a gauge, is part of that instrument, never a second item. A ball, gate or needle valve the row ties to the gauge ('for isolation', 'of suitable size', 'cost included in this item', 'with syphon') is part of the gauge too: one Pressure Gauge item. A 'provision' to connect a (digital) thermometer or thermowell 'in future' is a Test Plug / Thermowell (the provision is priced as a test plug). A differential pressure gauge is a Pressure Gauge; copy 'differential' in item_as_written. A thermometer 'with (necessary) isolation valves' is ONE Temperature Gauge / Thermometer item; return no valve item for its isolation valves. A pressure gauge 'provision' (sockets, ball valves, siphon to fix a gauge later) is a Test Plug / Thermowell; the gauge itself is not part of it.

attribute_definitions.label: Item as written
attribute_definitions.note: The item in the BoQ's own words. Copy the words exactly as the BoQ writes them, as one continuous piece; never shorten, never join pieces with '...' or any other mark; if the words are long, copy the shortest continuous piece that holds the value. When the row writes a count for an item ('two', '2 nos', 'pair of'), copy the count with the item's own words.

attribute_definitions.label: Size
attribute_definitions.note: Rubber bellows / flexible connections / expansion joints only: the pipe size AS WRITTEN (mm, NB, inches). A gauge's dial size is not asked. Copy the words exactly as the BoQ writes them, as one continuous piece; never shorten, never join pieces with '...' or any other mark; if the words are long, copy the shortest continuous piece that holds the value.

attribute_definitions.label: Scope
attribute_definitions.note: What the row pays for, from its own words first, then a heading describing it: supply + installation (SITC, supply & install, fixing ...), supply only, or installation only. 'None' when nothing is said. 'portable' or 'handed over' means Supply only. 'Supply of ...' and 'Supply and provisioning / providing ...' are Supply + installation (installation is included unless the BoQ says supply only or quotes installation on its own row) - answer the same way on every row with the same wording. Installation (installing, fixing, refixing) of items the row does not supply is Installation only - also refixing, reinstalling, shifting or relocating EXISTING or OLD valves. 'Lifting, shifting, positioning at site' in a list of what the price includes is not installation only.

attribute_definitions.label: Duct type
attribute_definitions.note: Which duct THIS row buys: Rectangular (GI); Spiral / Oval (GI) (spiral, flat oval, elliptical, and round / circular ducts priced per sq.m); Round (GI) - per metre (a round / circular duct the row prices per metre with its diameter); PIR (Pre Insulated Duct) (pre-insulated / PIR panel ducts); Fire Rated (MS) (MS / black steel / fire-rated / kitchen exhaust ducts). Answer from the row, or a heading that describes this row's duct. 'None' when the row names a duct but no shape. THE ITEM OF THE ROW DECIDES: when the row buys a duct, answer the duct even where its words also name what the duct connects to, what it is for, or what else is supplied with it (dampers, plenums, plenum boxes, grilles / diffusers, attenuators / silencers, flexible duct, butterfly dampers, access doors) - those are extras, not the item. A gauge 'for ducts above 2250 mm and plenum' is a duct of that gauge; a 'duct for return air plenum' is a duct; 'PIR panels' are PIR ducts; 'sheet metal ducts with acoustic lining' are ducts (Insulated Yes, the lining as their insulation item); a removal of existing ducts that also removes their insulation or silencers is a duct row. 'none of these' only when the item itself is not a duct (a damper, plenum box, grille, diffuser, silencer, flexible duct, canvas, turning vanes, a VRF / AC unit, a valve, a sensor or thermostat, a copper / refrigerant pipe, insulation on its own) - copy what it is in duct_type_as_written. A row that pays ONLY for painting, a fire-retardant coating or air balancing of ducts returns NO main item - only its Misc item.

attribute_definitions.label: Duct type as written
attribute_definitions.note: The duct shape / material words as the BoQ writes them for THIS row ('GSS rectangular', 'spiral flat oval', 'MS welded', 'aluminium', 'removal of existing duct'), one continuous piece. Leave out when none.

attribute_definitions.label: Gauge as written
attribute_definitions.note: The gauge and / or sheet thickness as written for THIS row ('24 G', '0.63 mm', '24G / 0.63 mm', '18 SWG'). Where the row or its notes give a gauge for each size band, copy that whole gauge-by-size text. Never an insulation thickness. Leave out when none.

attribute_definitions.label: Size as written
attribute_definitions.note: The duct size THIS row states, with its unit: the sides of a rectangular duct ('1500 x 600'), the diameter of a round duct ('150 mm dia', 'Ø 200'), the axes of an oval duct, or the size band ('up to 750 mm', '751-1500 mm'). Leave out when none.

attribute_definitions.label: Insulated
attribute_definitions.note: Yes when the row, or a heading describing this duct, asks for duct insulation or acoustic lining (any material / thickness); No only when it says not insulated; leave out when not mentioned. When Yes, also return the insulation as its own item in the insulation section.

attribute_definitions.label: Scope
attribute_definitions.note: What the row pays for, from its own words first, then a heading describing it: supply + installation (SITC, supply & install, fixing ...), supply only, or installation only. 'None' when nothing is said. 'Supply of ...' and 'Supply and provisioning / providing ...' are Supply + installation (installation is included unless the BoQ says supply only or quotes installation on its own row) - answer the same way on every row with the same wording. Installation (installing, fixing, refixing) of items the row does not supply is Installation only - also refixing, reinstalling, shifting or relocating EXISTING or OLD ducts. 'Lifting, shifting, positioning at site' in a list of what the price includes is not installation only. 'Labour charges' for duct erection / installation (no material) is Installation only.

rule_lines.title: A gauge written in the BoQ wins over a thickness also written; a standard thickness reads as its gauge
rule_lines.detail: '24G / 0.63 mm' -> 24G; 0.5-0.56 mm = 26G, 0.6-0.63 mm = 24G, 0.8 mm = 22G, 1.0 mm = 20G, 1.2-1.25 mm = 18G, 1.6 mm = 16G (not stocked); any other thickness takes the next thicker gauge; gauge words: G, SWG (18 SWG = 18G), gauge, and the misspellings guage / gause ('24 gause' = 24G)

rule_lines.title: Several gauges in one row: the gauge of this row's size band
rule_lines.detail: read from the gauge-by-size text in the row's own words ('22 G up to 751 to 1500 mm, 20 G 1501-2250 mm'); no band holding the row's size -> priced by hand

rule_lines.title: No gauge in the BoQ: the standard size table by the duct's size
rule_lines.detail: rectangular (longer side): up to 750 mm 24G, 751-1500 mm 22G, 1501-2250 mm 20G, above 18G; round / oval (diameter or major axis): up to 600 mm 24G, 601-1200 mm 22G, 1201-1500 mm 20G, above 18G; no size either -> priced by hand; the table is data the owner can change

rule_lines.title: A gauge not stocked takes the next THICKER gauge (the ladder runs reverse)
rule_lines.detail: thinner than the thinnest (26G) -> 26G with a note; thicker than the thickest (18G) -> priced by hand; MS 16G -> priced by hand

rule_lines.title: Which rows count as the sheet's own duct-insulation rows
rule_lines.detail: an insulation row whose own words or a heading above it name duct, or that sits under a plain 'Insulation' heading; never a row in running metres (pipe insulation), nor one whose own words or nearer heading name pipes, AHU / plant room / equipment, or a building surface (under deck, roof, wall, ceiling, floor) named by the row or by an insulation heading; a long scope preamble is not read as naming equipment

rule_lines.title: The 90% rule: the separate rows' quantity against the sheet's insulated duct quantity
rule_lines.detail: at or above the Pricing Input 'Ducting - insulation coverage threshold' ({threshold} today; exactly at = covered) -> no insulation line, the note names the rows; below it, or a quantity missing on either side -> the insulation line is priced with a possible-double-counting note naming the rows; no separate rows -> priced as usual; no row is left for a person

rule_lines.title: A borrowed section never reads the duct's gauge words
rule_lines.detail: '22G', '24 gauge' in the row are the duct's; Insulation's cladding check reads only its own words

rule_lines.title: Removal 0.5 x and refixing 1.0 x the duct's installation; both named -> 1.5 x
rule_lines.detail: no supply and no insulation; the installation read live from the matching duct item; the gauge does not matter (the installation does not vary by gauge); a removal row naming several duct shapes takes the higher shape's installation basis (oval / spiral 280 -> removal 140), note 'removal of mixed shapes - priced at the higher (oval) rate' (owner, 2026-11-16 15:21); removal / refixing rows only - any other row naming both shapes is not priced, 'BoQ names rectangular and oval - select the correct duct type' (owner 2026-11-17 00:28)

rule_lines.title: Installation only follows the Valve rule as built, with Ducting's own uplift on the supply-row case
rule_lines.detail: the supply quoted on its own row of the sheet -> the installation x (1 + 'Ducting - installation-only uplift', {uplift} today); no supply row -> supply + installation with a note; a 'Supply of' row with its installation on its own row -> supply only

rule_lines.title: A row read as not a duct refuses with its re-file sentence before any unit check
rule_lines.detail: a VRF unit, a valve, a thermostat or a copper pipe filed Ducting says which category to re-file it under, never 'unit not priceable'

rule_lines.title: A PIR duct row with no gauge read takes the panel thickness from its own words
rule_lines.detail: '20mm thick PIR Panels' -> PIR 20 mm, with a line saying the thickness came from the row's own words; no thickness words -> priced by hand

rule_lines.title: A 'labour charges' duct row read installation only is priced as the duct's installation only
rule_lines.detail: no supply; the installation x (1 + 'Ducting - installation-only uplift', {uplift} today); note: insulation installation is priced by Insulation's own rows

rule_lines.title: A gauge written any way reads as that gauge, on the panel and the calculator
rule_lines.detail: '24G', '24 g', '24   G', '24 gauge', '24 guage', '24 gage', '24 gause', '24 SWG', 'G24', '24-G', 'Guage: 24'; a bare whole number 16-30 in the gauge field is that gauge (never mm); a bare decimal below 3 (0.63, 1.0) is mm -> the standard-thickness table; a value typed in the calculator reads the same way, only a picked sheet mm is read as that number

rule_lines.title: Several gauges in the answer but the row's own words name one of them -> that gauge
rule_lines.detail: the answer copied the whole heading's band list; the row's own single gauge decides ('22 G up to 751 to 1500mm' -> 22G)

rule_lines.title: A labour row needs no gauge: the duct type decides its installation
rule_lines.detail: a 'labour charges' row is the duct's installation only, the same for every gauge of a type; its insulation is priced by Insulation's own rows, not here

rule_lines.title: A supply row whose installation the sheet quotes on its own row is priced supply only
rule_lines.detail: its own words start 'Supply of' (or the sheet heading repeated, then 'Supply of'); the same kind of duct quoted installation only on the sheet -> supply only, the note naming every such row and why

attribute_definitions.label: Item
attribute_definitions.note: The VAV Box sheet's own Item text, verbatim.

hvac_vav_box.notes: VAV-1 (2026-11-19): the VAV Box price sheet -- the workbook's VAV Box tab (84 box lines + 2 VAV Integrator lines; BoQ = ROUNDUP(BCS x 1.4) supply, ROUNDUP(BCS x 1.6) install) + the owner's 4 new SKUs and 'VAV installation - any size'; the Misc and Sensors items borrowed live under their own rules (list_spec.sections). The BoQ-row rules (the reading, the sheet checks, the panel) are VAV-2a / VAV-2b.

attribute_definitions.label: VAV item
attribute_definitions.note: Which VAV Box sheet item this line is: a VAV box (a VAV or CAV terminal box); the VAV Integrator; a BACnet over IP controller; a duct connection; a conical piece; integrator cabling (per metre); or the installation of a VAV box of any size. Answer 'none of these' for anything else and copy its words into 'VAV item as written'. A duct connection only when the row ASKS for one (e.g. 'with flexible duct connection'); a row that only says the box is 'suitable for duct connections' describes the box - that is NOT a duct connection item. A row for a controller for BACnet integration above the VAV boxes is the BACnet over IP controller, not the VAV Integrator.

attribute_definitions.label: VAV item as written
attribute_definitions.note: The item in the BoQ's own words. Copy the words exactly as the BoQ writes them, as one continuous piece; never shorten, never join pieces with '...' or any other mark; if the words are long, copy the shortest continuous piece that holds the value.

attribute_definitions.label: Shape
attribute_definitions.note: VAV boxes only: Rectangular or Oval, as the BoQ states. A box the BoQ calls round, oval or circular is Oval; 'DIA', diameter or the diameter sign give an inlet or sensor size, not the box shape.

attribute_definitions.label: Type
attribute_definitions.note: VAV box: Nothing specific mentioned, AHRI Certified, or AHRI Certified Imported. VAV Integrator: Nothing specific mentioned or Imported. As the BoQ states.

attribute_definitions.label: Integrator included in this rate
attribute_definitions.note: VAV boxes only: Yes when the box's rate includes its VAV integrator, No when it does not. A router or an integrator named in the row, its headings or their notes counts as mentioned (Yes), unless the sheet prices the integrator on its own row.

attribute_definitions.label: Airflow (CFM)
attribute_definitions.note: VAV boxes only: the airflow as the BoQ writes it, in CFM, e.g. '650 CFM', 'Up to 650 CFM', '500-650 CFM'; a range as written (the maximum is used). Answer 'None' if no airflow is stated. A lower limit only ('Above 3200 CFM', '3700 CFM above'): copy it with its word, e.g. 'Above 3200 CFM'.

attribute_definitions.label: Inlet size
attribute_definitions.note: VAV boxes only: the round inlet size as the BoQ writes it, in inches or mm, e.g. '8 inch', '200 mm dia'. Not a tag or item number. Answer 'None' if no inlet size is stated.

attribute_definitions.label: Airflow band (CFM)
attribute_definitions.note: VAV boxes only: the airflow band of the box on the VAV Box sheet, in CFM.

attribute_definitions.label: Qty per box
attribute_definitions.note: How many of this item go with one row unit (one box); for integrator cabling, the metres per box. Two of an item when the row asks for two ('two thermostats'; a piece 'on either side' = 2).

attribute_definitions.label: Scope
attribute_definitions.note: What the row pays for: supply + installation, supply only, or installation only. 'None' when nothing is said. A row or heading that says ITC or 'Installation of ...' and never says supply is not 'Installation only': answer 'None' (the helper decides the scope from the sheet).

attribute_definitions.label: Controller for the VAVs
attribute_definitions.note: VAV boxes only. Read THIS row's whole payload (its description, its own notes and the notes of the headings above it): is a controller FOR CONTROLLING THE VAVs mentioned? Only a controller that is for controlling the VAVs counts. 'ddc_inclusive' = a DDC controller or DDC panel (the two are the same thing) is part of the VAV box or its controller and the text makes it part of the price (e.g. 'Independent DDC VAV Controller with inbuilt pressure sensor', a box 'consisting of' / 'complete with' ... a DDC controller, 'inclusive of DDC controller'). 'ddc' = a DDC controller or DDC panel is part of the VAV box or its controller but the text does not say it is included. 'bacnet' = BACnet in any form (BACnet over IP, BACnet MS/TP, BACnet alone) for the VAV box, its controller or the VAV network. 'controller' = a controller for the VAVs with neither a DDC nor a BACnet word (e.g. 'controller for receiving Temp. & DP Signal', 'required controllers for controlling all the VAVs', the VAVs 'shall communicate through a network controller'). 'none' = no controller for the VAVs. NOT counted (answer as if those words were absent): a DDC or BACnet controller of OTHER equipment (an AHU's 'BACNET/IP DDC', a 'centralised controller for VFD operation'); a line about makes ('All VAV controllers, DDC controllers ... shall be of single OEM' names no DDC for the VAVs - its BACnet controllers still count as 'bacnet' when BACnet is named for the VAVs). When more than one applies, answer the first of: ddc_inclusive, ddc, bacnet, controller.

attribute_definitions.label: Controller by others
attribute_definitions.note: VAV boxes only: 'Yes' when the text says the VAV controller is supplied or installed by the BMS vendor or by others (e.g. '(VAV controllers and thermostats will be installed by the BMS vendor at site)'); otherwise 'No'.

attribute_definitions.label: DP sensor mentioned
attribute_definitions.note: VAV boxes only: 'Yes' when THIS row's payload mentions a DP sensor for the VAVs in any form - a differential pressure sensor, switch or transmitter, a 'DP sensor' / 'DPS', a duct static pressure sensor; every DP sensor mention counts. 'No' otherwise. A 'DP signal' alone, a pressure gauge, an air-flow monitoring station or the box's own velocity sensor is not a DP sensor.

attribute_definitions.label: Needs installing
attribute_definitions.note: VAV rows only: 'No' only when the item this row pays for does not need installing at site (e.g. attic stock the BoQ names explicitly, a spare part, a loose accessory or a software licence that is only handed over), with the reason in 'Why no installing'; otherwise 'Yes'. A row that only says 'Supply of ...' is 'Yes'.

attribute_definitions.label: Why no installing
attribute_definitions.note: When 'Needs installing' is 'No': a few words from the row saying why the item needs no installing (e.g. 'attic stock'). Otherwise 'None'.

sections.label: Misc item
sections.family_note: Which Misc item goes with THIS VAV box: Digital Thermostat (a thermostat for the box; a thermostat with a CO2 sensor or a CO2 display is TWO items - this Digital Thermostat and a CO2 Sensor under Sensor); Temperature Gauge / Thermometer = Room temperature sensor - priced at Misc's Temperature Gauge / Thermometer (a room temperature sensor with no thermostat); Transformation Pieces (a transition / transformation piece between the box and the duct). Answer 'none of these' for anything else and copy its words into 'Item as written'. A direct-output temperature sensor supplied with the VAVs is the Digital Thermostat, not the Temperature Gauge / Thermometer.

sections.label: Sensor
sections.family_note: Which sensor goes with THIS VAV box: CO2 Sensor (a CO2 sensor, also one that comes with a thermostat - a thermostat with a CO2 sensor or a CO2 display is TWO items: the Digital Thermostat under Misc item and this CO2 Sensor). A DP / differential pressure / duct static pressure sensor is NOT an item here: answer it in 'DP sensor mentioned' on the VAV box. Answer 'none of these' for anything else and copy its words into 'Sensor as written'.
